title: Get fast proof of Intent locations read recovery and settings problems

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage — `SEED-413#speed-intent-source-and-story-reading`

- **Verdict:** **Caught** (bounded to the observed path where published detail and Intent locations share an initial 15 s transient wait and published detail heals first while Intent locations remain unanswered for the 30 s step; this probe does not claim coverage of the reverse order where Intent heals while published detail remains unanswered).
- **Next proof action:** None required for the observed shared-wait / detail-heals-first path.
- **Prior disposition recognized (not a new repair decision from this probe):** `.planning/slice-plans/755-speed-intent-source-and-story-reading/PLAN.md` already retains authenticated HTTP boundary recovery and `headsChecks` continuation in `e2e/intent/intent-read-boundary-recovery.spec.ts` and splits the remaining 64 legacy reading cases into `SEED-413#speed-intent-source-browsing-and-detours` (`.planning/slice-plans/762-speed-intent-source-browsing-and-detours/PLAN.md`) and `SEED-413#speed-story-changes-notes-and-progress-reading` (`.planning/slice-plans/763-speed-story-changes-notes-and-progress-reading/PLAN.md`).

### Probe target and evidence

- **Story and revision:** `SEED-413#speed-intent-source-and-story-reading` (`.planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#speed-intent-source-and-story-reading`, `.planning/slice-plans/755-speed-intent-source-and-story-reading/PLAN.md`) at revision `3d1fef8a4f7b0f351a0c6ac37cad4eb2bd291f7a`.
- **Promise and expected observable behavior:** Shared transient recovery between published detail and Intent locations without conflation — when both a published-detail file read (`loadRepositoryTexts` with optional `readFile` + `recordSettledOutcomes`) and an Intent locations read (`ProjectIntentReading` inside `IntentReadRecovery`) fail with transient `ReadProblem`s, they share the initial 15 s recovery wait; when published detail heals on that 15 s reread while Intent locations fail again, `"Reading unanswered detail again"` clears while Intent remains pending and rereads on the 30 s step (`+30 s`) to show location `"scripts"`.
- **Fault introduced:** In `dashboard/src/transientRecovery.ts:52` inside `clearTransientFailure`, changed `if (pending.size === 0) {` to `if (pending.size >= 0) {` (1-line production edit; all test files, fixtures, and assertions left untouched) so clearing a healed contributor (`"published-observation"`) calls `clearAllTransientFailures()` even while `"intent"` is still pending.
- **Fixture and collaborators exercised:** `mountIntentRecovery` / `PageIntentRecovery` (`dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-read-recovery-page.tsx:62-155`) over `onRecoveryClock()` fake timers, `makeMe.aPublishedWork.ofPygardon.at("d3".repeat(20)).please()`, `makeMe.anIntentLocationsAnswer` locating `scripts` (`configuredLocations`), `controlledLocations(work)`, and controlled `detailRead` passed into `loadRepositoryTexts` (`dashboard/src/repositoryFileReads.ts:73,102`) alongside `ObservationOutcomes`, `recordSettledOutcomes`, `useLimitRecovery`, `PublishedReadStatus`, `IntentReadRecovery`, and `ProjectIntentReading`.
- **Maintained checks and catching assertion:** Focused command `caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard:frontend -- dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-read-recovery.spec.ts --workers=2` (5 Vitest `mounted-chromium` checks in `dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-read-recovery.spec.ts`). Caught by `await expect.poll(() => [detailReads, locations.reads()]).toEqual([2, 3])` at `dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-read-recovery.spec.ts:162` in `"published detail and Intent locations share a wait, and healing detail leaves Intent pending"` (`dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-read-recovery.spec.ts:125-165`), failing with `AssertionError: expected [ 2, 2 ] to deeply equal [ 2, 3 ]`.
- **Run observations (baseline, reach, wrong behavior, restoration):**
  - **Isolation and baseline:** Prepared detached scratch worktree `/tmp/dough-ic-755-370` at `3d1fef8a4f7b0f351a0c6ac37cad4eb2bd291f7a` with symlinked `node_modules` (pre-probe `git status --porcelain`: only `?? node_modules`). Focused baseline passed all 5 checks (`5 passed (5)`, Vitest runner `Duration 10.36s`, `282ms` on `:125`).
  - **Reach and independent wrong-behavior observation:** With only `dashboard/src/transientRecovery.ts:52` faulted (`git diff` verified), an independent Node module witness driving `loadRepositoryTexts` (via its optional `readFile` collaborator), `ObservationOutcomes`, `recordSettledOutcomes`, `noteTransientFailure("intent")`, and `transientRecoveryIsDue` across controlled `Date.now` recorded `{"dueAt14999":[false,false],"dueAt15250":[true,true],"intentDueAfter30s":false}` — confirming both contributors reached and shared the 15 s wait (`15,250 ms`) and that settling healed published detail wiped `"intent"`'s pending 30 s recovery (`intentDueAfter30s: false` at `45,500 ms`). In the untouched Vitest rerun (`exit 1`, runner `Duration 6.73s`), all 4 single-contributor checks passed (`390ms`, `190ms`, `607ms`, `189ms`), while `:125` verified initial `[1, 1]` failures and `"Reading unanswered detail again"` visibility, completed the shared 15 s reread `[2, 2]`, verified `"Reading unanswered detail again"` disappeared while Intent still showed `"could not be reached"`, held `[2, 2]` at `+29,000 ms`, and failed at `:162` (`[2, 2]` vs `[2, 3]`, `1663ms`) because Intent never performed its 30 s recovery reread.
  - **Restoration and cleanup:** An `EXIT` trap restored `dashboard/src/transientRecovery.ts`; post-restore `git status --porcelain` (`?? node_modules`) and empty `git diff` matched pre-probe state. Rerunning the same focused command passed all 5 checks (`5 passed (5)`, Vitest runner `Duration 6.38s`, `204ms` on `:125`). Removed `/tmp/dough-ic-755-370` via `git worktree remove --force` and verified `/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/get-fast-proof-of-intent-source-and-story-readin` remained clean and unedited.
